trap-nonspeakable.notes: THREE RECOMPUTED FLAGS for the report, none of which touch the five proved identities. (1) 'closes m_mu/m_e via Vol(4_1)/hbar_q^2 to 0.034 pct of CODATA' does NOT reproduce: Vol(4_1)/hbar_q^2 = 206.768326 at the proton pin against CODATA 206.7682830, i.e. +2.10e-5 pct = 209.8 ppb - which is exactly the documented mu-p substrate tension - and it is identically zero at the muon pin, where the relation IS the pin. The quoted 0.034 pct is ~1600x too large and matches neither pin. (2) 'closes m_tau/m_e via Vol(10_43)/hbar_q^2 to +0.79 pct' omits the xi_3 factor and is impossible as written: m_tau/m_e = 3477.23 needs Vol/hbar^2 = 34.137 without xi_3, far outside any 10-crossing volume, whereas the cited witness carries Vol(10_43) = 13.83304617 and predicted_xi_3 = 2.4873628890, and xi_3 Vol/hbar^2 = 3504.8 gives exactly the witness's rel_err_percent = 0.79443. So the muon sentence needs xi_2 EXCLUDED and the tau sentence needs xi_3 INCLUDED, using the same formula template. (3) 'numerical cross-checks ... verify each identity' names 3 assertions for 5 identities; the two omitted are the trivial cross-multiplied consequences, so the logic is fine but 'each' overstates. WITNESS CHECKED: tau-amphichiral-sdp-probe.witness.json exists, allPassed true, q0Anchor proton - but its assertion muon_canonical_pin_consistency computes 206.768283, which is the MUON-pin value of Vol(4_1)/hbar_q^2, not the proton-pin 206.768326 the header declares; a two-layer straddle to triage.
